method: Canonical Chrome driver and existing strategies, real simulation/crowd/world at 1/30 second fixed steps, normal player actions, no extra resources or policy changes. Isolated compiled development snapshot completed real application initialization and its 90-second warmup, then stopped before GPU compilation and animation frames. Only the strategy advanced the sim during measurements.
limits: Illustrative game balance, not empirical health outcomes.
Scenario nights are a minimum, not a deadline; reported losses mean not won within the measured window.
Prepared-lean is a separate explicitly documented strategy, not the ordinary prepared bot.
Retrospective final-goal scores of older traces are identified separately from live final-goal runs.
No graphics performance or physical headset/mobile validation was performed.
